question: Retrieve the names of players who scored no less than 100 runs in a match while playing for the team that lost that match.
sql:
-- Final query: Get distinct player names who scored >= 100 runs in a match while playing for the losing team
SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM player_match pm
JOIN ball_by_ball bbb ON pm.match_id = bbb.match_id 
    AND pm.team_id = bbb.team_batting
    AND bbb.striker = pm.player_id
JOIN batsman_scored bs ON bbb.match_id = bs.match_id 
    AND bbb.over_id = bs.over_id 
    AND bbb.ball_id = bs.ball_id
JOIN match m ON pm.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN player p ON pm.player_id = p.player_id
GROUP BY pm.match_id, pm.player_id, pm.team_id, m.match_winner, p.player_name
HAVING SUM(bs.runs_scored) >= 100 AND pm.team_id != m.match_winner
ORDER BY p.player_name
